name: Sertraline
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: MAO inhibitors (including linezolid and IV methylene blue), within 14 days

key_interactions.effect: Higher pimozide levels; QT prolongation and ventricular arrhythmias (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Other serotonergic drugs (SSRIs, SNRIs, triptans, tricyclics, opioids including tramadol, lithium, buspirone, St John's wort)
key_interactions.action: Monitor, especially at start and dose increases; stop if serotonin syndrome occurs.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Antiplatelets and anticoagulants (aspirin, clopidogrel, heparin, warfarin), NSAIDs
key_interactions.action: Warn the patient; monitor INR closely with warfarin.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CYP2D6 substrates (metoprolol, propafenone, flecainide, desipramine, venlafaxine, tolterodine)
key_interactions.action: Lower the CYP2D6 substrate dose if needed; raise it again if sertraline is stopped.
Monitor phenytoin levels; reduce the dose if needed.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: QT-prolonging drugs (some antipsychotics, erythromycin, moxifloxacin, class IA and III antiarrhythmics)
